note: Alberta Parks campground in Sibbald Lake Provincial Recreation Area, run by Cedar & Spruce Campgrounds: 53 km east of Canmore on Hwy 1, 6 km south on Hwy 40 and 12 km east on Hwy 68. Mostly treed sites; Loop E is tent-only. Cook shelter, playground, and a hand launch on Sibbald Lake. Bring drinking water: the hand pump is for fires only. Nearest sani-dump at the Kananaskis Visitor Information Centre. --Claude
